$description: GeoMap (platform/charts/GeoMap.jsx; library wave 9, lane C): its component tokens. Choropleth regions and markers take data-viz colors (data-plx-dataviz); land, outlines and gaps are existing roles.

geo-map-default-color.$description: Map: a marker's color without data-plx-dataviz (the first categorical color).

geo-map-land.$description: Map: a region without a value (an outline map, or no data on a choropleth), in the sunken surface color.

geo-map-border-color.$description: Map: the outline between regions of an outline map.

geo-map-border-width.$description: Map: the width of the outlines and gaps between regions (kept when zoomed).

geo-map-gap-color.$description: Choropleth map: the gap between shaded regions, in the surface color.

geo-map-marker-outline.$description: Map: the ring around a marker in the surface color, so it stands off the regions.

geo-map-controls-gap.$description: Map: the space between the zoom buttons and the map.
